title: Second nonzero projected D-delta-D boundary Taylor coefficient
question: For a local configuration character and one neighboring canonical Q3 bond, what is the exact third generator difference after the first nonzero second-order coefficient, and what operator degrees must a positive-time orbit estimate control?
decision_reason: Direct symbolic CCR action shows that the first boundary coefficient vanishes, the second is the cubic Q3 force, and the third is an explicit first-order differential operator with cubic force, quadratic force derivative and linear second derivative terms. Independent rational grid checks and Lean R255 preserve this as a finite coefficient bridge and expose the mixed force-momentum/modular obligations for the live orbit gate.
method: Represent p_q as -i*hbar*partial_q on a polynomial CCR test function and compute L_H=i[H,.]/hbar for H_0=T+V_0 and H_1=H_0+B.
Use configuration commutation to verify D'(0)=0 and recover the EXP-001058 second coefficient.
Expand the third difference and retain the linear shift contribution in [B,(p_q+a/2)^2], obtaining the exact A_1 and A_0 coefficient form.
Recompute the selected rational fixture and all 36 grid component ceilings in a Fraction-only lane, then compile Lean R255 for the selected values and degrees.
finding: On the finite CCR core, D'''(0)=W_a*(A_1*partial_q+A_0), with A_1=-a*F'/chi^2-3*i*a^2*F/(chi^2*hbar) and A_0=-a*F''/(2*chi^2)-2*i*a^2*F'/(chi^2*hbar)+3*a^3*F/(2*chi^2*hbar^2). For chi=hbar=c=1, lambda=1/10, a=1/4 and (q,v)=(3,-2), (F,F',F'')=(12,59/10,12/5), A_1=-59/40-9i/4 and A_0=-3/160-59i/80; the 6x6 grid ceilings are 59/40, 9/4, 9/80 and 59/80.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing exact finite CCR-core coefficient bridge. It does not prove a positive-time evolved-force estimate, modular-domain control, direct D or delta-D Cauchy, product/core density, exhaustion independence, group law, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, KMS/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.

adversarial_review.check: Direct differential-operator action checks signs and hbar factors.
The linear a*[F,p] contribution is retained in the shifted kinetic commutator.
Configuration V_0 commutes with the boundary multiplier and does not alter the coefficient.
The result stops at D'''(0) and does not sum the real-time series.
R255 checks exact rational selected values and degrees only.
Positive-time orbit, direct D/delta-D, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
